links.outcome: Local validation of published length-of-stay model: discrimination and calibration on local data
links.effect: Original model performed poorly in local validation dataset, grossly overestimating length of stay; performance improved after intercept and coefficient adjustment but remained poorly calibrated at low and medium thresholds.
links.quote: The original model performed poorly in the validation dataset, grossly overestimating length of stay.

links.outcome: Effect of local model adjustment (intercept and coefficients) on performance
links.effect: Performance improved following adjustment of model intercept and coefficients, though the adjusted model remained poorly calibrated at low and medium risk thresholds and net benefit was modest.
